LightningComponentBundle.description: Pre-apply landing page showing existing applications with status and resume/view actions.

property.description: Elementary, Middle, or High. Filters form questions by school level.
property.label: School Level
property.name: variant

property.description: DeveloperName of the Application_Page__mdt record for Step 4.
property.label: Page Developer Name
property.name: pageDevName

property.description: Which applications to show. 'in-progress' = open/editable only (use on the Dashboard tab). 'submitted' = Applied/Eligible/Withdrawn (use on the Application Status tab). 'all' = everything.
property.label: Applications Shown
property.name: view

property.description: Hide the navy 'My Applications' header bar. Turn ON for the Dashboard tab (it sits under the family welcome); leave OFF for the Application Status tab.
property.label: Hide header
property.name: hideHeader

property.description: Show the 'Welcome, <Family>!' greeting and intro at the top. Turn ON for the Dashboard tab.
property.label: Show welcome greeting
property.name: showWelcome

property.default: We are delighted to welcome you to your one-stop destination for your child’s enrollment at Zeta.
property.description: Intro text shown under the welcome greeting.
property.label: Welcome message
property.name: welcomeMessage
